findings.why: state.pop(key, None) is unreachable through the only writer in scope: append never emits a delete line after a put on the same key (same-rid delete replays the put, different-rid raises ConflictError), so a delete line is always a tombstone on a never-put key and pop never removes an existing entry; FR-9(a)'s delete-removes-key half has no reachable path and thus no test coverage today.
normalize_key(line["key"]) is redundant on the read path because append already writes NFC-normalized keys; harmless defense-in-depth, not a defect.
